name: stupid fragile girlthing makes a mess of everything
source:
Elke (they/them) and Abigail (she/her) are a long distance lesbian couple who make visual novels together for fun. anyways, Elke is jealous of Abbi's ability and recognition as a writer, jealous of how much time she spends with friends, and insecure about every single thing. It's a recipe for success in any relationship!

*pukes*

[From [url=https://ilu-beato.itch.io/stupidfragile]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃爾克（人稱代名詞為they/them）和阿比蓋爾（人稱代名詞為she/her）是一對遠距交往的女同性戀伴侶，閒來以一起做視覺小說為樂。總之呢，埃爾克嫉妒阿比當作家的本事和收穫的認可，嫉妒她花那麼多時間陪朋友，對每一件事都缺乏安全感。哪段感情湊齊這些要素能不成功呀！

＊嘔＊

［摘自[url=https://ilu-beato.itch.io/stupidfragile]itch.io[/url]］
